lines.text: Leo spent two hours carefully balancing wooden blocks into a magnificent twenty-story castle!
He reached for the final golden spire at the very top... CRASH! The tower collapsed!
Blocks scattered in every direction! Leo felt hot tears in his eyes and wanted to stomp them!
His grandfather knelt beside the wooden rubble and asked, What did the blocks teach you?
Leo looked at the floor: the base was narrow and thin like a pencil!
Castles need a wide, rock-solid foundation to hold up heavy grand towers above!
Leo laid down eight wide blocks on the carpet, rebuilding the strongest castle in history!
Mistakes are not failures—they are secret clues that show you how to build better next time!
Build your wisdom and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
